about_description: Scrob - Open Source, Self-hosted media tracking app. It syncs your libraries from Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby, tracks your watch history, ratings, and personal lists - Your own private Letterboxd + Trakt.
about_credits_intro: Scrob connects to the following third-party services through their publicly documented APIs. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or certified by any of them.
about_built_with: Built with Astro, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
about_tmdb_notice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by {tmdb}. Metadata is also provided by {tvdb}.
about_trademarks: All product names, logos, brands, and trademarks shown in Scrob are the property of their respective owners and are used only to identify the services Scrob interoperates with. Their use does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by them.

profile_settings_picture_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · Max 5 MB
profile_settings_display_name_hint: Shown instead of your username where your name appears.
profile_settings_region_hint: Used to show relevant streaming availability on the Discover page and filter content for your region.
profile_settings_content_language_hint: Filter Discover recommendations to your preferred original language.
profile_settings_metadata_language_hint: Titles, overviews, and taglines will be fetched from TMDB in this language. Translations are cached as you browse — library metadata updates gradually as you visit detail pages. The language of menus and buttons is set in Settings.
profile_settings_backfill_desc: Fetch translated metadata for all items in your collection and watch history at once.
profile_settings_streaming_hint: Select the services you subscribe to. The Discover page will highlight content available on your services.
profile_settings_genres_hint: Pick the genres you enjoy most. The Discover page will show dedicated rows for your favourites.
profile_settings_disliked_hint: Genres you want to avoid. Items that only have disliked genres are filtered out of recommendations and picks. Mixed items (some liked, some disliked) can still appear. A genre can't be in both lists — selecting one here removes it from your favourites.
settings_a_server_wide_tmdb_token_is: A server-wide TMDB token is configured by your admin. You can leave this blank to use it, or enter your own token to override it.
settings_a_server_wide_tmdb_token_is_2: A server-wide TMDB token is configured, but you are using your own token. Clear this field to fall back to the server token.
settings_paste_the_api_read_access_token: Paste the API Read Access Token (v4) from TMDB Settings → API. Required for metadata and posters; validated before saving.
settings_a_server_wide_tvdb_key_is: A server-wide TVDB key is configured by your admin.
settings_a_server_wide_tvdb_key_is_2: A server-wide TVDB key is configured, but you are using your own key.
settings_powers_shows_and_episodes_not_o: Powers shows and episodes not on TMDB, TVDB-ordered (absolute / anime) episode mapping, and matching unmatched local episodes. Without a key those fall back to TMDB only.
settings_optional_personal_key_for_ratin: Optional personal key for rating posters. Leave blank to disable and use original artwork. Scrob fetches the posters from RPDB server-side, so your key is never exposed in the page.
settings_randomize_the_order_of_the_next: Randomize the order of the Next Up row on the homepage. When off, shows are ordered by most recently watched.
settings_show_the_next_up_row_like: Show the Next Up row like any other row, without the large banner and title text.
settings_hide_items_you_ve_already_watch: Hide items you've already watched from the Recently Added row on the homepage. They still appear when viewing the full collection.
settings_on_the_watch_history_page_colla: On the Watch History page, collapse episodes of the same show watched on the same day into a single row instead of listing each one individually.
settings_when_something_finishes_playing: When something finishes playing and drops off the Now Playing bar on the homepage, show a quick star-rating popup for it. Skipped for anything you've already rated.
settings_if_a_movie_or_episode_is: If a movie or episode is already in your history within this many minutes, a new watch of it (from any source - webhook, import, or manual) is skipped instead of recorded again. A small built-in minimum always applies even if you leave this blank.
settings_blur_posters_flagged_as_adult_c: Blur posters flagged as adult content by TMDB. Click a blurred poster to reveal it.
settings_display_watch_times_in_24_hour: Display watch times in 24-hour format (e.g. 23:31) instead of 12-hour (e.g. 11:31 PM).
settings_use_the_hls_based_player_for: Use the HLS-based player for Plex and Jellyfin/Emby sources. Enables transcoding if your browser doesn't natively support the file's codecs. Disable this if playback is broken.
settings_re_fetches_posters_and_dates_fo: Re-fetches posters and dates for collection items that are missing them due to TMDB errors during sync.
settings_fixes_episodes_stuck_as_unmatch: Fixes episodes stuck as "unmatched" where the show title was lost — usually affects items synced before the title-preservation fix. Restores the title from sync history so the Match button works.
settings_heal_duplicate_watch_history_fr: Heal duplicate watch history from Jellyfin/Emby pushes
settings_removes_duplicate_history_entri: Removes duplicate history entries created by buggy sync.
settings_heal_items_stuck_as_unwatched_f: Heal items stuck as unwatched from Jellyfin/Emby
settings_removes_history_entries_stuck_a: Removes history entries stuck as unwatched from a fixed sync bug, so the next sync can record their real status.
settings_retroactively_collapses_watches: Retroactively collapses watches of the same movie/episode recorded within a window you choose - e.g. the same play logged once by a webhook and again later by an import from another source (#390).
settings_removes_all_active_now_playing_: Removes all active now playing sessions. Use this if a ghost session is stuck in the bar after a restart or network interruption.
settings_protect_your_account_with_a_tim: Protect your account with a time-based one-time password (TOTP) from any authenticator app.
settings_scan_the_qr_code_with_your: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.), then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
settings_save_these_backup_codes_somewhe: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each can only be used once. They cannot be shown again — regenerate them in settings if needed.
settings_your_account_is_protected_with_: Your account is protected with an authenticator app.
settings_enter_your_authenticator_code_o: Enter your authenticator code or a backup code to disable 2FA.
settings_used_codes_are_shown_with_strik: Used codes are shown with strikethrough and cannot be reused. Keep these somewhere safe.
settings_download_your_watch_history_rat: Download your watch history, ratings, collection, lists, and comments as a zip.
settings_permanently_deletes_all_watch_h: Permanently deletes all watch history and progress. Your collection and ratings will not be affected.
settings_permanently_deletes_all_your_ra: Permanently deletes all your ratings. Your watch history and collection will not be affected.
settings_permanently_removes_all_items_f: Permanently removes all items from your collection. Your watch history and ratings will not be affected.
settings_permanently_deletes_all_your_li: Permanently deletes all your lists, including Watchlist, and everything in them. Your watch history, ratings, and collection will not be affected.
settings_once_you_delete_your_account_th: Once you delete your account, there is no going back. All your data will be permanently removed.
settings_choose_what_to_include_in_the: Choose what to include in the export.
settings_this_will_re_fetch_posters_and: This will re-fetch posters and dates for collection items that are missing them. It runs in the background and may take a few minutes.
settings_this_will_permanently_delete_yo: This will permanently delete your account and remove all your data. This action cannot be undone.
settings_tvdb_key_help: Create a free project key at thetvdb.com/api-information (key only, no PIN; requires attribution, which Scrob shows on TVDB pages). A subscriber-supported key also needs your account's subscriber PIN above.
settings_rpdb_help: Choose poster style and ratings in the RPDB manager. Feature availability for your current plan is managed by RPDB.
export_secrets_warning: These include API keys and tokens in plain text — only enable if you understand the risk.
settings_rpdb_invalid: RPDB could not validate this API key. Check the key and try again.
clear_history_body: Are you sure you want to clear your entire watch history? This cannot be undone.
clear_ratings_body: Are you sure you want to clear all your ratings? This cannot be undone.
clear_collection_body: Are you sure you want to clear your entire collection? This cannot be undone.
clear_lists_body: Are you sure you want to delete all your lists, including Watchlist, and everything in them? This cannot be undone.
admin_these_settings_apply_to_all_users: These settings apply to all users. A user's own settings always take priority if configured on their profile.
admin_required_for_all_users_who_don: Required for all users who don't set their own token.
admin_let_admins_customize_root_folder_q: Let admins customize root folder/quality profile/tags when adding
Let admins customize root folder/quality profile/tags/season folders when adding
admin_hides_the_comments_section_from_ev: Hides the comments section from every media detail page for all users.
admin_configure_media_caching_limits_and: Configure media caching, limits, and system performance optimizations.
admin_cache_poster_backdrop_and_still_im: Cache poster, backdrop, and still images from TMDB and TheTVDB locally on the server to improve load times and support offline mode.
admin_set_a_maximum_storage_limit_in: Set a maximum storage limit in GB (fractional values allowed, e.g. 1.5). Oldest accessed images will be pruned when the limit is exceeded. Set to 0 or leave empty for unlimited.
admin_server_wide_operations_that_run_ac: Server-wide operations that run across all users' collections.
admin_re_enrich_all_items_across_every: Re-enrich all items across every user's collection that are missing poster or date metadata. Uses the global TMDB Read Access Token, falling back to your own from account Settings.
admin_delete_all_locally_cached_tmdb_and: Delete all locally cached TMDB and TheTVDB image files, and clear their database records. Files will be re-downloaded on-demand when requested.
admin_download_a_full_sql_dump_of: Download a full SQL dump of the database. Keep it somewhere safe.
admin_this_will_re_enrich_all_items: This will re-enrich all items across every user's collection that are missing poster or date metadata. It runs in the background and may take a while on large libraries.
admin_tvdb_help: Server-wide fallback for TVDB-sourced shows and TVDB-ordered episode mapping. A free project key from thetvdb.com/api-information needs no PIN; a subscriber-supported key needs the PIN below.
admin_mdblist_help: Server-wide fallback for importing public MDBList lists. User sync, push, and scrobble features still require a personal MDBList connection.
admin_restore_help: Upload a .bak backup file to restore. All existing data will be overwritten.
admin_browse_anon_hint: Lets visitors navigate the app, and view public profiles and lists, without signing in.
admin_browse_anon_requires_tmdb: Requires a TMDB read access token (above) before this can be enabled.
admin_enter_url_key_first: Enter {service} URL and API key first.
admin_sole_admin: You are the sole admin. Promote another user first.
admin_delete_self_body: Deleting your own account ({username}) will log you out immediately. This cannot be undone.
admin_delete_user_body: Are you sure you want to delete {username}? This cannot be undone.
admin_clear_cache_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear the image cache? This will delete all cached posters and backdrops.
admin_disable_2fa_confirm_body: {username} will be able to sign in with just their password until they set up 2FA again.
conn_the_account_key_is_stored_server: The account key is stored server-side and is never exposed here.
conn_reconnecting_replaces_the_stored_ac: Reconnecting replaces the stored account key and keeps your existing sync settings.
conn_refresh_token_stopped_working_sign_: Refresh token stopped working? Sign in again
conn_signing_in_replaces_the_refresh_tok: Signing in replaces the refresh token above with a fresh one and reconnects immediately.
conn_required_to_attribute_events_when_m: Required to attribute events when multiple users share a server.
conn_leave_all_unchecked_to_sync_every: Leave all unchecked to sync every library.
conn_automatically_request_items_added_t: Automatically request items added to your Plex watchlist. Requires Radarr / Sonarr to be configured in settings.
conn_sign_in_with_plex_to_fill: Sign in with Plex to fill in the server URL and token automatically.
conn_pick_the_address_scrob_should_use: Pick the address Scrob should use to reach this server. Reachable ones are marked; you can also edit the URL field directly.
conn_authorize_scrob_from_stremio_withou: Authorize Scrob from Stremio without sharing your password.
conn_these_seasons_are_successfully_rema: These seasons are successfully remapped. Episodes sync correctly — you can edit or remove the mapping if needed.
conn_webhook_only_connections_for_scrobb: Webhook-only connections for scrobbling. No URL or token needed — just pick your server type and enter your username or user ID so events can be attributed to you.
conn_your_jellyfin_emby_user_id_used: Your Jellyfin/Emby user ID, used to match webhook events to your account.
conn_your_plex_username_used_to_match: Your Plex username, used to match webhook events to your account.

Each holds a write-scoped token — it can change your watch history, ratings and lists, but not your password, email or security settings. Revoking takes effect immediately.
conn_use_this_key_to_authenticate_reques: Use this key to authenticate requests to the Scrob API. Keep it secret — if it leaks, regenerate it immediately.
conn_these_restore_api_keys_and_connecti: These restore API keys and connections from the export. Existing values are never overwritten — only gaps are filled.
conn_collection_and_lists_only_come_from: Collection and Lists only come from a Floppy export - a vanilla Yamtrack file has neither, and simply won't add anything for those.

conn_search_for_the_show_on_tvdb: Search for the show on TVDB

conn_push_all_historical_watched_items_f: Push all historical watched items from Scrob to Bingebase
